findings.title: Missing GitHub Actions CI workflow for automated matrix testing
findings.description: packages/alex-local/scraper-core lacks a .github/workflows/tests.yml file to continuously test pull requests across PHP 8.2, 8.3, 8.4 and Laravel 11, 12, 13 on Ubuntu and Windows runners.
findings.evidence: Directory .github/workflows does not exist in package root.
findings.recommendation: Create .github/workflows/tests.yml with matrix testing strategy using composer update --prefer-dist.
